facts.fact: Before reporting, residents should check the bin was out on the correct day, was clearly visible to the crew, is a council-supplied bin, and that the report is within two working days of the collection day. The council aims to return for a missed collection within two to five working days.

If the wrong bin was put out, or the bin contained contamination or items the council cannot collect such as rubble or clinical waste, the bin is not treated as missed. Contamination must be removed and the bin is collected on the next scheduled day.
